name: Google Sheets SOW Exporter
description: Parses a JSON SOW from the chat, creates a multi-page Google Sheet, and returns the URL.
author: Gemini

input.placeholder: Paste your full Google Service Account JSON credentials here.
input.hint: The full JSON key for the service account that has Google Drive/Sheets API access.

input.placeholder: Enter the Google Sheet ID to use as a template.
input.hint: The ID of the sheet to copy. Found in the sheet's URL.

sowJson.description: The full JSON blob of the SOW generated by The Architect.
